page: Google Cloud Platform n2-standard-2 is a general-purpose virtual machine belonging to the n2 server family. It features 2 vCPUs mapped to 1 physical Intel Xeon core with 2 threads per core, operating at a base frequency of 2.8 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The instance is configured with 8.0 GB of dedicated system memory, providing 4.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include local storage or integrated GPU hardware.

Benchmark evaluations place the n2-standard-2 in the lower performance tiers for most compute and memory operations. The instance achieved a single-core stress-ng score of 1398.19, which is in the bottom 25%, and a multi-core score of 1837.38, placing it in the bottom 10%. Memory bandwidth tests show 102.01 GB/sec for cached small blocks and 13.8 GB/sec for uncached large blocks, both ranking in the bottom 10%. Single-threaded gzip compression is a relative highlight, performing in the middle 50% at 23.81 GB/sec, whereas bzip3 decompression single-threaded performance drops to 8.56 GB/sec.

Given its performance profile, the n2-standard-2 is suited for lightweight general-purpose workloads that do not require high memory bandwidth or dense multi-core processing. Passmark database operations and Redis SET operations both fall in the bottom 10%, indicating limitations for high-throughput database tasks. Similarly, static web serving throughput is measured at 1.95 GB/sec, and LLM inference speeds for a small 135M model reach 34.16 tokens per second for text generation. This server is best utilized for basic web serving, development environments, and low-intensity background tasks.
